content: .{@-लेख@} {%a.%} of beautiful outlines, highly arched; रुचिस्तव कलावती रुचिरचित्रलेखे श्रुवौ <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. ({@-खा@}) .²1 a portrait, picture. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a friend and companion of Uṣā, daughter of Bāṇa. [When Uṣā related to her her dream, she suggested the idea of taking the portraits of all young princes in the neighbourhood; and on Uṣāʼs recognising Aniruddha, Chitralekhā, by means of her magical power, conveyed him to her palace.]
